snippet.title: Nightmare Neighborhood | Trick-Or-Treat Game Trailer
snippet.description:
AVAILABLE NOW itch.io: https://lockedon.itch.io/nightmare-neighborhood

Nightmare Neighborhood is a trick-or-treating roguelike visual novel where you must manage your resources, wear different costumes to double dip houses, all to collect as much candy as you can without getting eaten by the monsters who inhabit the Neighborhood.
